newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ASIA Ltd guarantees US$500 mln note programme.
newsitem.headline: ASIA Ltd guarantees US$500 mln note programme.

text.p: Asian Securitization & Infrastructure (Pte) Ltd (ASIA Ltd) said on Monday it has agreed to guarantee a US$500 million medium term note programme for the Securitization & Infrastructure Funding Corp (SIFCO).
Based on ASIA Ltd's guarantee, the SIFCO programme is expected to be rated AA+ by Nippon Investors Service, AA by Duff & Phelps and A by Standard & Poors, ASIA Ltd said in a statement.
SIFCO has received approval in-principle from the Stock Exchange of Singapore and the Luxembourg Stock Exchange to list the notes which may be issued under the programme.

The programme, arranged by Nomura Singapore Ltd, will initially provide for issuance of notes denominated in any agreed currencies including marks, Hong Kong dollars, Indonesian rupiah, yen, Thai baht, and U.S. dollars.

The notes may have maturities ranging from one month to 30 years from date of issuance, and may be issued on a fully-paid or partly-paid basis and at an issue price at par or at a discount to, or premium over, par.
The programme is intended for international investors with interest in the Asian region, ASIA Ltd chief executive officer Philip Sherman was quoted as saying.

"The programme's flexibility will be very useful in accommodating the needs of both borrowers and investors. We hope that it will in many ways facilitate development of the Asian debt capital markets," he said.

ASIA Ltd is a financial guarantee company set up by Capital Markets Assurance Corp of the U.S., the Asia Development Bank and the Government of Singapore Investment Corp with several leading institutional investors to provide financial guarantees for infrastructure and securitization financings for Asian issuers.

SIFCO was incorporated last month and its activities will be limited to issuing the notes and purchasing, investing in, selling and exchanging investments, using the income generated by such investments to pay interest on the notes and related expenses.

Other shareholders in ASIA Ltd include Employees Provident Fund of Malaysia, the American International Group 's American International Assurance Ltd, Korea Long Term Credit Bank, DEG-Deutsche Investitions und Entwicklungs gesellschaft mbH, and Netherlands Development Finance Co, the statement said.
